title: In praise of the half-finished brief
excerpt: The best projects we have had started with a paragraph and a deadline. Why a rough brief beats a polished one.
content:
The best projects we have had started with a paragraph and a deadline. The worst started with forty pages that three departments had signed off.

A brief is a question, not an answer

A polished brief has usually decided what the work should be. A rough one still asks what the problem is, which is the part we are useful for.

  • Who are we trying to reach?
  • What do they believe now?
  • What would make this a success in a year?

Send it early

If you can answer those three, you have a brief. Send it to us before someone makes it longer.
